Synopsis:
Ukraine and Russia are engaged in tit-for-tat strikes on Black Sea grain infrastructure during peak export season, disrupting grain terminal operations and forcing cargo delays/cancellations. The Kremlin is downplaying supply disruption risk, citing ~60Mt available for export and pledging timely shipments, while Russia's August grain exports are expected to rise modestly to 2.2Mt from 1.95Mt in July.
